title: B2AGI Physical AI 2027: Current 100 Companies
selection_type: contribution-based selection; record IDs are not ranks

records.name: 42dot
records.selection_rationale: TAP handles ride requests and reservations for the Cheonggyecheon autonomous bus. Government service records describe its platform role alongside 42dot’s technical materials.
records.evidence_scope: 2022–2024 TAP service records and platform role; current model technology is documented separately.

records.name: AgiBot
records.selection_rationale: AgiBot G2 was deployed on Longcheer’s tablet production line, as described in the customer’s account of its production process.
records.evidence_scope: Customer and supplier announcements; operating figures are company-reported, and the Q3 figure of 100 robots is a plan.

records.name: Agile Robots
records.selection_rationale: Agile Robots brought idealworks into its group through an acquisition, combining robotics development with BMW logistics automation.
records.evidence_scope: Acquisition announcement and BMW logistics application records; subsidiary contributions are recorded at group level.

records.name: Agility Robotics
records.selection_rationale: Digit transfers totes to a conveyor at GXO’s SPANX distribution center. GXO announced the deployment and a multiyear service agreement in 2024.
records.evidence_scope: GXO customer announcement, June 2024: task, deployment and RaaS contract; the robot version in photographs requires separate identification.

records.name: AIDIN Robotics
records.selection_rationale: AIDIN supplies AFT200 force/torque sensing used in demonstration capture and physical Franka manipulation research.
records.evidence_scope: ManipForce v1, III-A and IV-A.2: sensor integration in capture and physical robot execution.

sources.locator: Sections III-A "F/T Data Acquisition" and IV-A.2 "Robot Setup": AIDIN AFT200 in demonstration capture and physical Franka execution. Policies/results belong to the authors.

records.name: Amazon
records.selection_rationale: Amazon deploys, tests and expands robotics within its order-fulfillment operations, acting as the customer responsible for logistics tasks.
records.evidence_scope: Amazon’s account of deployment in operations facilities; company financials cover the whole business.

records.name: Ambi Robotics
records.selection_rationale: AmbiSort applies Sim2Real technology to logistics sorting. Pitney Bowes describes using the system in customer statements published with the product materials.
records.evidence_scope: AmbiSort product documentation and supplier-published Pitney Bowes statements cover existing use and expansion contracts.

records.name: AMP Robotics / AMP
records.selection_rationale: AMP installed and operated neural-network-based material sorting at the Portsmouth facility. Its facility case includes a customer manager’s account of the work.
records.evidence_scope: Supplier facility case and 2025 acquisition announcement; facility throughput and robot-arm performance have distinct scopes.

records.name: ANYbotics
records.selection_rationale: ANYmal applies learned control to industrial inspection. ANYbotics describes customer operations using the robots.
records.evidence_scope: Company account of industrial inspection operations; customer counts, reliability and payback figures are company-reported.

records.name: Applied Intuition
records.selection_rationale: Applied Intuition supplies vehicle simulation and testing software. TRATON confirms their existing collaboration on development tools.
records.evidence_scope: TRATON customer announcement covering five years of tool collaboration; deployment of the new vehicle OS is planned.

records.name: Autonomous a2z
records.selection_rationale: Autonomous a2z’s ROii carried passengers on the Cheonggye A01 shuttle. Seoul’s trial-service notice and a passenger account describe supervised operation.
records.evidence_scope: Seoul trial-service notice and passenger observations; an onboard supervisor can intervene manually.

records.name: Baidu
records.selection_rationale: Baidu reports driverless ride activity through Apollo Go. Its contribution is autonomous passenger-service operation.
records.evidence_scope: Issuer operating disclosures; ride counts have a different scope from paid orders, revenue and profitability.

records.name: Bedrock Robotics
records.selection_rationale: Bedrock retrofits excavators for autonomous digging at named infrastructure customers including Sundt. Its announcement describes sensing, learned models and operation beyond the supervised trial stage.
records.evidence_scope: Bedrock’s deployment announcement describes autonomous digging within supervisor-defined work plans and permitted areas.

records.name: Berkshire Grey
records.selection_rationale: Berkshire Grey supplies RPSi parcel sorting at FedEx facilities. FedEx describes existing installations and everyday sorting work.
records.evidence_scope: FedEx’s 2022 installation account; later purchase plans and warrant conditions are separate events.

records.name: BlackRock
records.selection_rationale: BlackRock operates RBOT as an investment route into listed robotics and automation companies.
records.evidence_scope: RBOT fund operation, portfolio holdings and assets under management.

records.name: Booster Robotics
records.selection_rationale: Booster supplies K1 and T1 robots used by the HTWK team in research and RoboCup. Team documents describe competition operation and a learned kick executed on T1.
records.evidence_scope: Team documents and joint research; team learning and firmware contributions retain their own attribution.

records.name: Boston Dynamics
records.selection_rationale: Boston Dynamics supplies robots for commercial trailer unloading at customer sites.
records.evidence_scope: Customer unloading records; the additional commitment of more than 1,000 robots is an MOU, while Atlas development is a separate activity.

records.name: Brain Corp
records.selection_rationale: Brain Corp provides route-learning autonomy for cleaning machines used at Walmart.
records.evidence_scope: Existing customer-use records; the figure of 360 additional machines was a deployment plan.

records.name: Built Robotics
records.selection_rationale: Built Robotics completed autonomous solar pile installation with its Gen1 system at a named EPC site.
records.evidence_scope: Project report published through a public agency; evidence concerns the Gen1 deployment and its defined construction task.

records.name: Burro
records.selection_rationale: Burro provides autonomous transport at Sierra Gold. A named operations manager describes workers using the robots in nursery tasks.
records.evidence_scope: Burro publishes Sierra Gold’s account of workers using the robots for nursery transport.

records.name: Carbon Robotics
records.selection_rationale: Carbon Robotics uses plant recognition to guide LaserWeeder’s laser weeding. Named farms describe using the equipment.
records.evidence_scope: Supplier-published customer testimony; savings and yield effects lack independent verification.

records.name: CATL
records.selection_rationale: CATL describes deploying Galbot S1 on module and battery-pack production lines. Its contribution combines customer adoption with battery supply for robotics.
records.evidence_scope: CATL's announcement describes the system and reports eight-hour operation and battery failure specifications.

records.name: Cognex
records.selection_rationale: Cognex supplies neural-network-based vision for industrial inspection. Its filings document a perception role within production processes.
records.evidence_scope: Industrial-vision filings. Financial figures cover consolidated GAAP results for FY2025, ending 2025-12-31, in USD millions; machine vision includes rule-based systems and barcode products.

records.name: Corvus Robotics
records.selection_rationale: Corvus supplies inventory drones used at multiple MSI Surfaces warehouse sites.
records.evidence_scope: Supplier account of named-customer use; accuracy and return-on-investment claims are company-reported. MSI Surfaces is the customer.

records.name: Coupang
records.selection_rationale: Coupang uses people and robots together in fulfillment operations. It represents the customer’s role in deploying automation for order handling.
records.evidence_scope: Operator accounts; overall infrastructure investment has a wider scope than robot purchases, and time-saving figures are party-reported.

records.name: Covariant
records.selection_rationale: Covariant Brain supports everyday learned picking and sorting at Radial’s TradePort2 facility in Louisville.
records.evidence_scope: Radial’s 2023 customer announcement; throughput and SKU coverage are customer-reported, while later expansion plans are separate.

records.name: DeepRobotics
records.selection_rationale: DEEP Robotics provides the X30 platform behind SPock power-tunnel patrols. SP Group’s operating account and the integrator’s hardware description identify the customer task and platform.
records.evidence_scope: Customer patrol records and integrator description; feature versions are specific to each deployment.

records.name: Dexterity
records.selection_rationale: Dexterity supplies trailer-loading robotics at FedEx’s Hagerstown hub. The customer describes deployment beyond a pilot.
records.evidence_scope: Joint customer announcement documenting the loading application.

records.name: Diligent Robotics
records.selection_rationale: Diligent Robotics’ Moxi handles hospital deliveries. CHLA documents repeated deliveries and use by its hospital teams.
records.evidence_scope: Hospital-use records and supplier material; deliveries support hospital logistics. Serve’s separate delivery business retains separate attribution.

records.name: DJI
records.selection_rationale: DJI supplies drones used in China Southern Power Grid's route-based inspection. Its later Dock workflow account documents further vendor-reported inspection use in oil and gas.
records.evidence_scope: DJI's named powerline-inspection case dated 2019-05-08; Dock 3 release dated 2025-02-27; unnamed oil/gas operator workflow account dated 2026-02-20, with some AI integrations at experimental stage.

sources.locator: DJI customer case, 2019-05-08: Intelligent Machines at Work and A New Generation of Work; route-based aerial inspection at China Southern Power Grid.
2026-02-20; unnamed operator, repeatable routes, alarm-triggered launch, thermal/RGB capture; some AI integration is experimental.
Dock 3 release, 2025-02-27: routing, image capture and temperature-notification features.

records.name: Doosan Robotics
records.selection_rationale: An external Royal IHC project team used Doosan's 1013 arm in a vision-guided welding prototype. Doosan supplied the manipulation platform; the team developed the vision, integration and welding application.
records.evidence_scope: Smart Manufacturing & Robotics Delft project account published 2025-03-16, covering fall 2023: Doosan 1013, RealSense D415, OpenCV detection and TCP motion commands in a constrained welding prototype.

sources.locator: Published 2025-03-16, fall 2023 project. "Solution," "Integration," "Program," "Important Decisions": Doosan 1013, D415, OpenCV, TCP motion commands and welding prototype.

records.name: Dreame Technology
records.selection_rationale: Dreame X40 Master performs navigation, obstacle recognition and floor cleaning in a hands-on review that also records recognition errors.
records.evidence_scope: Affiliate-linked product test; Master-specific observations are retained, and borrowed Ultra Complete measurements have separate scope.

records.name: Dyna Robotics
records.selection_rationale: Dyna Robotics applies robot learning to garment folding at Monster Laundry. The owner describes daily folding work.
records.evidence_scope: Customer quotation; people load and collect garments. Inconsistent time and quantity statements are excluded from performance claims.

records.name: Ecovacs
records.selection_rationale: Ecovacs DEEBOT OZMO T8 AIVI was used in a direct test covering vacuuming, navigation and camera sensing.
records.evidence_scope: RTINGS hands-on test of the base T8 AIVI; mopping was untested in that account, and long-term customer statistics are unavailable.

records.name: Elephant Robotics
records.selection_rationale: Elephant Robotics supplies arms and AI kits used in named university teaching and physical student projects.
records.evidence_scope: Undated supplier university cases documenting adopted educational platforms and student-developed tasks.

sources.locator: Supplier account, Educational Cases: Fudan University AI kits and university teaching examples.

records.name: Farm-ng
records.selection_rationale: Farm-ng supplies Amiga as an adopted agricultural education platform in the recurring Farm Robotics Challenge, including CMU's seedling-planting project; university teams retain attachments and task development.
records.evidence_scope: UC ANR account, 2025-05-08: third annual Farm Robotics Challenge, Amiga educational-platform use and CMU's physical seedling-planting project.

sources.locator: 2025-05-08, CMU Appleseed Labs/Johnny B. Root award and Farm-ng technology-partner paragraphs. Amiga base and CMU attachments retain separate attribution.

records.name: Field AI
records.selection_rationale: Field AI provides autonomy for Spot-based inspection at changing construction sites. Its account describes perception, mapping and use by site managers.
records.evidence_scope: Field AI describes a deployment at an unnamed construction customer, covering perception, mapping and inspection.

records.name: Figure AI
records.selection_rationale: Figure 02 handled sheet-metal parts during BMW's extended Spartanburg production pilot.
records.evidence_scope: BMW report, 2026-02-27, pp. 4-5: ten-month pilot with weekday production shifts.

sources.locator: 2026-02-27, printed pp. 4-5: Spartanburg Figure 02 production pilot, ten months and weekday shifts.

records.name: Flexiv
records.selection_rationale: Flexiv’s delivered Rizon 4 solution locates fish fillets on a moving conveyor and shapes them using force control.
records.evidence_scope: Supplier case for a specific delivered application; the customer is unnamed and independent acceptance and performance tests are unavailable.

records.name: Formic
records.selection_rationale: Formic supplies vision-based packaging and palletizing as a service. Its product account includes customers describing active production use.
records.evidence_scope: Supplier-published customer statements; installed software versions, uptime and commercial terms require deployment-specific evidence.

records.name: ForwardX Robotics
records.selection_rationale: ForwardX Flex assists picking in Li & Fung’s IKEA e-commerce warehouse. Its product materials describe visual perception and movement responses.
records.evidence_scope: Supplier customer case and product-family technical material; performance and feature versions are supplier-reported.

records.name: Foxglove
records.selection_rationale: Foxglove provides development and operating-log tools used by Square Robot for field analysis.
records.evidence_scope: Named-customer tool-use record; the contribution concerns software analysis, while the customer retains responsibility for robot operations.

records.name: Galbot
records.selection_rationale: Galbot S1 works on CATL module and battery-pack lines. CATL describes deployment, visual positioning and obstacle avoidance.
records.evidence_scope: CATL customer announcement; evidence concerns S1 production-line use, with future staffing and service-standard plans recorded separately.

records.name: Gaussian Robotics / Gausium
records.selection_rationale: Gausium supplies cleaning robots adopted at named ELVI stores.
records.evidence_scope: Customer article republished by the supplier; subsequent investment is recorded as planned.

records.name: Geek+
records.selection_rationale: Geek+ provides warehouse movement within projects documented by implementation participants. People retain the picking role in the integrated workflow.
records.evidence_scope: Implementation participants describe the warehouse project and the division between robot movement and human picking.

records.name: GelSight
records.selection_rationale: GelSight supplies the Mini sensor used by Politecnico di Milano researchers to acquire tactile measurements on industrial components with a FANUC collaborative robot. The researchers retain the anomaly-detection methods and evaluation.
records.evidence_scope: Research v1, 2026-08-31, sections 3.3 and 4: adopted Mini instrumentation for robot-mounted dataset acquisition and external inspection-method comparison.

sources.locator: Version 1, 2026-08-31; sections 3.3 Acquisition Hardware and Protocol and 4 Implemented Feature-Embedding Methods: Mini sensor on FANUC CRX-10iA; external researchers' acquisition and method comparison.

records.name: GXO
records.selection_rationale: GXO operates Digit at its SPANX site, integrating tote transfers with existing mobile robots and conveyors under a multiyear RaaS agreement.
records.evidence_scope: GXO customer announcement; contract price, cash flows, residual value and measured uptime are undisclosed in the record.

records.name: HAI Robotics
records.selection_rationale: HAI Robotics supplies ACR and AMR warehouse systems, including a Hyundai Mobis application.
records.evidence_scope: Hai Robotics' Hyundai Mobis case describes tote retrieval and parts transport at the Suwon High Tech Center's spare-parts warehouse. Picking workstations retain the human picking step. This record recognizes the warehouse-system contribution described in that case.

records.name: HaptX
records.selection_rationale: HaptX supplies tactile gloves adopted in Sanctuary's development workflow, providing human teleoperation input.
records.evidence_scope: Sanctuary customer account and HaptX robotics cases, undated: gloves used in the customer's pilot-rig teleoperation workflow; autonomous robot tasks remain development.

sources.locator: Undated, "Sanctuary AI" and "Tactile Telerobot": adopted tactile teleoperation hardware.
Sanctuary account, paragraph beginning 'We use HaptX gloves': pilot-rig teleoperation input.

records.name: Hesai
records.selection_rationale: Hesai’s Pandar sensors are used on WeRide vehicles. Supplier materials include the customer’s account of sensor adoption.
records.evidence_scope: Supplier-published customer statement; evidence identifies a sensing component within the vehicle system.

records.name: Horizon Robotics
records.selection_rationale: Horizon Robotics supplies Journey6M computing for NOA features in delivered customer vehicles.
records.evidence_scope: Driver-assistance supply records; Journey 6M delivery and the planned 6H deployment retain their distinct product stages.

records.name: Hyundai Motor Group
records.selection_rationale: Hyundai Motor Group completed its controlling investment in Boston Dynamics in 2021. The joint announcement recorded an 80% group stake at closing.
records.evidence_scope: 2021 transaction announcement; the stake belongs to the group-level transaction, and current ownership requires separate evidence.

records.name: InOrbit
records.selection_rationale: InOrbit supports monitoring and remote exception management for Kärcher KIRA B50 cleaning robots.
records.evidence_scope: Customer statement and RobOps case; operations include remote support, with autonomy and certification assessed at the robot-system level.

records.name: Intuitive Surgical
records.selection_rationale: Intuitive Surgical’s Ion supports shape-sensing catheter manipulation for bronchoscopy and biopsy. North Tees describes trial adoption and actual biopsies in 2025.
records.evidence_scope: Hospital account documenting physician-assisted use of the specified system version in the reported cases.

records.name: JLG — Canvas Robotics
records.selection_rationale: JLG acquired Canvas core technology and integrated its team, carrying forward construction-robotics capabilities through a completed technology transfer.
records.evidence_scope: JLG January 2026 announcement: technology acquisition and team integration; further integrated solutions are planned.

sources.locator: January 2026, opening paragraphs: technology acquisition and team integration.

records.name: John Deere
records.selection_rationale: John Deere’s See & Spray recognizes plants and applies selective spraying in customer fields. Its commercial approach includes performance-linked charging.
records.evidence_scope: Supplier savings claims and sponsored research; evidence is specific to the cited fields and billing arrangement.

records.name: Keenon Robotics
records.selection_rationale: Keenon’s DINERBOT and cleaning systems perform transport and service tasks at named restaurants and hotels, with staff handoffs and obstacle avoidance.
records.evidence_scope: Supplier-published customer statements; newer humanoid demonstrations are separate development records.

records.name: Kodiak Robotics / Kodiak AI
records.selection_rationale: Kodiak supplies customer-owned trucks for limited off-road transport at Atlas.
records.evidence_scope: Supplier delivery and transport reports; evidence covers the off-road domain and its stated operating scope.

records.name: Locus Robotics
records.selection_rationale: Locus robots assist human picking across multiple customer sites with repeated tasks.
records.evidence_scope: Customer-use records; cumulative task totals have a different scope from profitability, failure rates and unattended operation.

records.name: Meituan
records.selection_rationale: Meituan operates drone and ground delivery systems. Its technical account connects sensing and autonomous movement with actual delivery orders.
records.evidence_scope: Company operating totals; drone and ground-vehicle periods and denominators remain separate.

records.name: Mobile Industrial Robots / MiR
records.selection_rationale: MiR250 transports KLT containers at BORG Automotive, with MES completion confirmation. Customer and integrator statements describe the workflow.
records.evidence_scope: Supplier-published interviews; MiR hardware, Octant integration and customer picking retain separate contributions.

records.name: Momenta
records.selection_rationale: Momenta supplies driving intelligence for named production customers including SAIC IM and Lynk.
records.evidence_scope: Production-customer records covering L2 to L2++ functions; planned L3 and L4 functions are separate.

records.name: Mytra
records.selection_rationale: Mytra supports inventory buffering and sequencing before shipment at selected Albertsons distribution centers.
records.evidence_scope: Mytra publishes Albertsons staff statements about inventory buffering and sequencing at selected distribution centers.

records.name: NAVER / NAVER LABS
records.selection_rationale: NAVER and NAVER LABS operate repeated internal deliveries at 1784, integrating robots with the building and elevators.
records.evidence_scope: Internal customer-operation records; the parent and development subsidiary share one activity record, with external sales assessed separately.

records.name: Nearthlab
records.selection_rationale: Nearthlab’s NearthWind performs autonomous wind-turbine blade inspection. Its materials describe sensing, flight and inspection contracts with Siemens Gamesa, Vestas and GE.
records.evidence_scope: Supplier contract history and cumulative totals; inspection volumes and safety records are company-reported.

records.name: Nimble Robotics
records.selection_rationale: Nimble supplies robotic fulfillment used by named brands for picking, packing and shipping; later alliance plans extend that operating contribution.
records.evidence_scope: Supplier customer cases including Fresh Clean Threads' 2023 fulfillment; FedEx alliance announcement, 2024-09-05.

sources.locator: 2024-09-05, alliance/investment and expansion; future network distinguished from existing work.
Undated live case section; Fresh Clean Threads 2023 picking/packing/shipping and other named-brand fulfillment. Supplier-reported operations.

records.name: NVIDIA
records.selection_rationale: NVIDIA’s Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab and GR00T support robot simulation, learning and deployment. Its May 2025 announcement names platform users including Agility, Boston Dynamics and Galbot.
records.evidence_scope: Platform-use announcement; financial figures are company-wide consolidated GAAP for FY2026 ending 2026-01-25, in USD millions. The release tables are marked unaudited; user-site effects require user-specific evidence.

records.name: Orbbec
records.selection_rationale: Orbbec’s Gemini 336L supplies RGB and depth streams for Quasi Model C2. A customer engineer describes SDK integration into Q.AI.
records.evidence_scope: Supplier-published customer statement; sensor supply and Quasi’s mapping, planning and control retain separate attribution.

records.name: OrionStar
records.selection_rationale: OrionStar CarryBot transports materials between processes at a Yanai Denki factory in Japan.
records.evidence_scope: 2025 company-republished newspaper account of deployment; newspaper text and fleet-wide outcomes lack separate verification.

records.name: OSARO
records.selection_rationale: OSARO provides learned vision and control for Zenni packaging, with later records describing transition into production.
records.evidence_scope: OSARO’s records distinguish the 2022 packaging plan from the subsequent production transition at Zenni.

records.name: Parallel Domain
records.selection_rationale: Parallel Domain supplies synthetic perception-training data used by named organizations including Google, Woven and Toyota Research Institute.
records.evidence_scope: Supplier customer-use claims; cited abstracts provide limited independent attribution of the particular dataset.

records.name: Path Robotics
records.selection_rationale: Path Robotics supplies a welding cell used by Millerbernd to fabricate transport and infrastructure poles. The case includes a welder describing the work.
records.evidence_scope: Supplier case and worker quotation describing the welding application.

records.name: Pickle Robot
records.selection_rationale: Pickle Robot unloads UPS trailers using motion and path selection in actual handling work.
records.evidence_scope: Supplier-published customer quotation; the cited 90-minute task is distinct from a shift-average measure.

records.name: Plus One Robotics
records.selection_rationale: Plus One’s PickOne provides vision recognition for FedEx parcel sorting, while Yonder supports remote exception handling.
records.evidence_scope: The FedEx site record describes Plus One’s vision and remote exception handling alongside Yaskawa’s arm, gripper and integration.

records.name: Pudu Robotics
records.selection_rationale: PUDU CC1 Pro cleans carpets and floors in shared areas of a Walmart US office facility, using navigation and path planning.
records.evidence_scope: Supplier case covering office common areas; publication date and independent labor-saving logs are unavailable.

records.name: Quicktron
records.selection_rationale: Quicktron M-Series moves shelves in Coupang’s goods-to-person workflow. RCS and higher-level systems allocate warehouse tasks.
records.evidence_scope: Supplier case; people perform final picking, and fleet counts and efficiency figures are company-reported.

records.name: RightHand Robotics
records.selection_rationale: RightPick performs picking at apo.com and PALTAC. Named customer statements describe operating use and learning features.
records.evidence_scope: Supplier-published statements; storage and transport by AutoStore or Murata have separate roles, while order totals cover the wider workflow.

records.name: Roborock
records.selection_rationale: Roborock Saros Z70 recognizes and picks up a limited range of objects while cleaning. A purchaser’s test records both use and failures.
records.evidence_scope: Qualitative hands-on review; observations include automatic and manual operation, with no formal success-rate measurement.

records.name: ROBOTIS
records.selection_rationale: ROBOTIS supplies actuators and physical platforms used in research and education, including dual-arm learning work.
records.evidence_scope: Supplier index and user research paper; evidence covers component use in research, with commercial returns assessed separately.

records.name: Roboto AI
records.selection_rationale: Roboto AI supports post-flight QA for BRINC and robot-fault analysis for ANYbotics. Named customer staff describe using the tools.
records.evidence_scope: Supplier-published customer statements; time-saving claims lack independent audit, and the contribution concerns data analysis.

records.name: Robust.AI
records.selection_rationale: Robust.AI’s Carter transports totes and assists picking at Saddle Creek’s Charlotte site. A named operations manager describes its use.
records.evidence_scope: Supplier-published customer statements; announced charging policies and productivity claims have separate financial and measurement scopes.

records.name: Rockwell Automation
records.selection_rationale: Rockwell integrates MES with OTTO transport at its Twinsburg factory, dispatching moves from production orders.
records.evidence_scope: Internal factory-use case; dispatch is rule-based, and cost-recovery figures are company calculations.

records.name: Saildrone
records.selection_rationale: Saildrone performs repeated ocean-observation missions for NOAA, transmitting measurements used in public scientific datasets.
records.evidence_scope: NOAA multi-year mission records; navigation autonomy operates with a defined supervision scope, while scientific analysis has separate attribution.

records.name: Samsung Electronics
records.selection_rationale: Samsung’s filings document acquisition of control over Rainbow Robotics and its consolidation into the group.
records.evidence_scope: Financial filings on strategic ownership; payments for existing shares are distinct from new cash raised by Rainbow.

records.name: Sarcos → Palladyne AI
records.selection_rationale: Palladyne AI supplies learned software for automated surface preparation at Warner Robins. A named customer describes completion of the first contract phase.
records.evidence_scope: Supplier-published customer statement; the second phase was planned, and the four-year contract amount is distinct from cash received.

records.name: Seoul Robotics
records.selection_rationale: Seoul Robotics supplies external perception for vehicle movement inside a BMW factory.
records.evidence_scope: BMW customer material; partner systems handle driving plans, steering and braking within the factory domain.

records.name: Shadow Robot
records.selection_rationale: Shadow Robot co-developed DEX-EE hardware with DeepMind and supplies the released standard research hand used in DeepMind's DemoStart experiments. Hardware development and supply retain joint credit; DeepMind retains its learning method.
records.evidence_scope: Shadow account, 2024-06-06: standard build available to the market; DeepMind account, 2024-09-12: adopted DEX-EE hardware in physical manipulation research.

sources.locator: 2024-09-12; Learning robotic behaviors from few simulated demonstrations; DEX-EE paragraph and caption: physical research use and joint hardware development.
2024-06-06; Developed with the world's leading AI researchers and Iteration at the cutting edge: research-tool requirements and released standard build.

records.name: SoftBank
records.selection_rationale: SoftBank completed a secondary Symbotic share purchase and established the GreenBox joint-venture vehicle for warehouse automation.
records.evidence_scope: Joint announcement, 2023-07-24: completed ownership transaction and established vehicle; initial funding and multiyear purchases are commitments.

sources.locator: 2023-07-24, "Transaction and Implementation Details": completed secondary share purchase, established vehicle, planned initial funding.

records.name: Standard Robots
records.selection_rationale: Standard Robots supplies AMRs used to transport pallets at TRUSCO’s Planet Saitama logistics center.
records.evidence_scope: TRUSCO customer announcement; evidence concerns the deployed transport system, while newer VLA features have separate scope.

records.name: Superbin
records.selection_rationale: Superbin’s Nephron uses AI classification in installed recycling-collection units.
records.evidence_scope: Installation and maintenance history; repeated references to the same 100-unit event count as one event.

records.name: Symbotic
records.selection_rationale: Symbotic supplies logistics automation systems documented in filings alongside customer contracts.
records.evidence_scope: Operating systems and contractual commitments have separate status; the 400-system figure is a conditional purchase commitment.

records.name: Syrius Robotics / Syrius Technology
records.selection_rationale: Syrius provides picking-assistance AMRs through Syrius Japan and ROBOCREW at STOCKCREW. The customer announced completed trials and full deployment beginning in 2022.
records.evidence_scope: Customer’s 2022 announcement; people perform picking. Supplier fleet and five-year contract figures have separate verification status.

records.name: UBTECH
records.role: Industrial humanoid supply and factory tasks
records.selection_rationale: UBTECH reports industrial humanoid production and delivery for automotive-factory handling, sorting and inspection. Its selected contribution is the supply of robots for those tasks.
records.evidence_scope: UBTECH 2025 results filed with HKEX on 2026-03-31, printed pp. 2-4 and 10-11; supplier industrial application page describing named-factory tasks, accessed October 2026.

sources.locator: Issuer announcement filed 2026-03-31, printed pp. 2-4 and 10-11: Walker development and delivery, industrial tasks, and product-and-service sales.
UBTECH industrial applications: NIO, BYD, Geely Auto, Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor and FAW-Volkswagen Qingdao task and site descriptions.

records.name: Unitree Robotics
records.selection_rationale: Unitree supplies physical robots used in external whole-body motion research.
records.evidence_scope: External research preprint; evidence concerns physical-platform use in research.

records.name: Universal Robots
records.selection_rationale: Universal Robots supplies UR5e arms used by eternal.ag for greenhouse harvesting. The case includes the customer CTO’s account.
records.evidence_scope: Supplier-published customer case; AI-model development, crop yield and long-term operating economics have distinct attribution.

records.name: Viam
records.selection_rationale: Viam provides fleet data, status checks and code deployment for Tennibot. Named customer leaders describe practical use.
records.evidence_scope: Supplier-published customer case; further AI integration was planned, while fleet support capacity differs from actual deployment.

records.name: VisionNav Robotics
records.selection_rationale: VisionNav VNL16 transports materials through inbound, shelving and outbound workflows for an equipment manufacturer, following scans and RCS instructions.
records.evidence_scope: VisionNav describes an unnamed manufacturer’s inbound, shelving and outbound workflow. Continuous operation is a stated target.

records.name: Waymo
records.selection_rationale: Waymo operates rider-only passenger services across multiple US regions. Its operating disclosure and California deployment-permit record identify autonomous passenger-service operation.
records.evidence_scope: Waymo operating data through June 2026; CPUC deployment-permit table accessed October 2026; manufacturer recall 25E-034 filed with NHTSA on 2025-05-12.
